lines.text: Mempire's market meta is written on chain by a Chainlink CRE workflow. This is a real run of cre workflow simulate, with broadcast, against Monad testnet.
The workflow compiles, then each node fetches the day's price changes. The nodes agree coin by coin on a median, turn each move into a bounded buff or nerf, and sign a report.
The report goes through the forwarder to our MarketMeta contract on Monad: a new epoch, thirty-six fighters, in about eight seconds.
Here is that transaction, read straight from the chain: success, and the MetaPosted event from MarketMeta.
In the game, the arena's boards update at once, and every staked match locks that epoch, so both players fight on the same, checkable numbers.
This run used the CRE simulator and its forwarder; the workflow is not deployed to a DON yet.
